A0.instructions: Does `item.text` commit to this outcome, either as new work or by keeping it working: an item that carries `#[sc_lint(allow(PORT-010), reason = "...")]` is not reported by PORT-010? Accept words such as honour, skip, suppress, exempt, records no finding, or not reported for the annotated item, function or declaration. Investigating, discussing or documenting site allowances without committing to that outcome does not count, and neither does a change to the attribute that never says PORT-010 leaves the annotated item unreported. Judge presence of the outcome only; do not judge conflict.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item conflicts with PORT-010 leaving an annotated item unreported, whether or not the item mentions site allowances.
criteria.unclear: The item says something about PORT-010 allowances that might or might not leave an annotated item reported.
criteria.yes: The item states that an allow(PORT-010) annotated item is still reported, that PORT-010 ignores, drops or refuses the site allowance, or that per-item PORT-010 allowances are not provided.

K0.instructions: Does `item.text` state a plan or outcome that `anchor.statement` rules out? It does when the item says PORT-010 still reports an item carrying `#[sc_lint(allow(PORT-010), reason = "...")]`, that PORT-010 ignores or no longer supports that site allowance, or that per-item PORT-010 allowances will not be provided and a broader mechanism is used instead. Silence about site allowances, planning only to investigate them, requiring the `reason`, or limiting the allowance to the annotated item or to the PORT-010 rule is not a conflict. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item does not touch PORT-010 site allowances: it changes which shapes PORT-010 reports without mentioning allow attributes, concerns allowances for other rules only, or is other work such as lint-step env or cwd, SCB-MANIFEST rules or release work.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether it touches PORT-010 site allowances.
criteria.yes: The item adds, changes, removes or reworks PORT-010's handling of a per-site #[sc_lint(allow(...))] allowance, including parsing allow(PORT-010) or replacing per-item PORT-010 allowances with another mechanism.

R0.instructions: Does the work in `item.text` add, change or remove how a per-site `#[sc_lint(allow(...))]` attribute allows PORT-010 findings, or set whether PORT-010 honours such an attribute? PORT-010 work that never mentions site allowances, such as recognising companion shapes or keeping real parity gaps reported, is a different subject, and so are site allowances for rules other than PORT-010. Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys `anchor.statement`.

R1.instructions: Does the work in `item.text` add, change or remove how a per-site `#[sc_lint(allow(...))]` attribute allows PORT-010 findings, or set whether PORT-010 honours such an attribute, in crates/sc-lint-portability, crates/sc-lint-directives or crates/sc-lint-attributes? Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys `anchor.statement`.
